charts.title: TOI-470 b: orbits around TOI-470
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-470's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-470 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Oddo et al. 2023 (2023AJ....165..134O), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ODDO_ET_AL__2023): P 12.19148 d

charts.title: TOI-470 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-470 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (6, 33, 87) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 37770169, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 12-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 12-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
